fact: The World Bank's implementation status report of 21 May 2025 records that at 1 March 2025 the National Health Information System was installed and operational in 2 selected hospitals against a target of 13 by August 2025, and that the share of health workers regularly using and updating the patient's electronic medical record during consultations was still 0 per cent against a target of 70.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: eGabon (P132824), Seq No 16
